由獨立的 Codex、Claude、Grok、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor 或 Cline 會話與 local 工作空間所支援的持久化 agents。
自定義 OpenAI 相容的 endpoints 與自定義 ACP agents，並具備對 local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) 與已安裝 agents 的偵測功能。
針對每個 agent 進行 context 監控，並在長對話耗盡 model window 之前自動進行 compaction。
具備暫停、恢復、取消與 crash-safe 持久化功能的 FIFO 訊息隊列。
Agent-to-agent 訊息、回覆、反應、圖片以及受管理的檔案傳輸。

repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repos.intro: Turn ordinary WiFi into a spatial intelligence / sensing system. Detect people, measure breathing and heart rate, track movement, and monitor rooms — through walls, in the dark, with no cameras or wearables. Just physics.
features: Presence and occupancy — detect people through walls, count them, track entries and exits
Vital signs — breathing rate and heart rate, contactless, while sleeping or sitting
Activity recognition — walking, sitting, gestures, falls — from temporal CSI patterns
Environment mapping — RF fingerprinting identifies rooms, detects moved furniture, spots new objects
Sleep quality — overnight monitoring with sleep stage classification and apnea screening
repos.description_zh: π RuView 將通用的 WiFi 訊號轉化為即時空間智慧、生命徵象監測與存在偵測 —— 這一切完全不需要任何影像像素。
repos.intro_zh: 將普通的 WiFi 轉化為空間智慧 / 感測系統。偵測人員、測量呼吸與心率、追蹤移動並監控房間 —— 能夠穿透牆壁、在黑暗中運作，且無需攝影機或穿戴式裝置。僅靠物理原理。
features_zh: 存在與佔用 —— 透過牆壁偵測人員、計算人數、追蹤進出
生命徵象 —— 呼吸率與心率，非接觸式，可在睡眠或坐著時進行
活動辨識 —— 透過時間序列 CSI 模式辨識走路、坐下、手勢與跌倒
環境地圖繪製 —— 透過 RF fingerprinting 識別房間、偵測移動的家具、發現新物體
睡眠品質 —— 進行隔夜監測，包含睡眠階段分類與呼吸中止症篩檢
repos.description_src: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
